meta.title: Windows Screenshot
meta.description: Adds a Windows-native screenshot camera button to the composer's left tool row, next to the attachment and permission controls. Choose Area, Window, or Full screen, pick a delay of Off, 1, 3, 5, or 10 seconds, then press Start capture. The Windows-native snip overlay appears; when it finishes, the PNG is attached to the current chat draft automatically and saved under DSH_HOME/screenshots. Windows only; while a 0-second capture is running the DSH window stays where it is, so use a delay to switch windows first.
